meta.caveat_line: 79 reviews from 48 students, collected in October 2026. Some courses got only one or two, so the review count sits beside every number. Tips are students' own words, tidied for clarity.
meta.band_midpoints_note: avg_ica_midpoint is a sort key only; the published scorability metric is pct_41_plus, a direct count.
meta.moderation_note: Every tip shown has been through a moderation pass: no faculty named, no profanity, course-level advice only. The free-text 'why not' answers are not published at all.

oes.name: Financial Derivatives
oes.display_tip: Pay attention in class. It's almost entirely numericals with minimal theory, and the maths is basic with some logic.
tips: Fully numerical, so pick it if you like numbers. Very simple too. Expect to lose 4-5 marks on the project or viva. Midterms are easy 10s, so don't make mistakes there.
